```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-acynw
vectorfield_plot(y ~ 2, x ~ 2-y , 
                 domain(y = 0:5, x = 0:5),
                 npts = 9,
                 stretch = 0.6) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed())
```

1. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-tss-1-k3")` The y-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of x.

::: {.callout-tip collapse=true}
In fact, the flow arrows don't vary at all with x.
:::

2. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-tss-2-ws")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of y.

::: {.callout-tip collapse=true}
The x-component of flow is sometimes up and sometimes down. Which it is depends on the value of y.
:::

3. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-tss-3-8d")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of x.

4. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-tss-4-is")` The y-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of y.

:::
